name: PF1_plan
brief: 2026-11-27 Polymarket-first from Dublin, offline test of the Lighter x Polymarket arb (PF1), Part B
written_before: any PF1 dev-day result was computed. V0 (11-26/27) and V1 (synthetic) may be run before this file is committed; V2 and the dev grid are run after it is pushed.
code: pf1/ on branch research/pf1 (engine.py, sim.py, run_day.py, agg.py); the commit that adds this file

data.polymarket: Dublin feeds-rec pmbook (BTC 15m, both tokens, top 5; Dublin receive ns + exchange ms), Up token top 3 kept (Down = mirror); 11-14 from shadow-rec pm (top of book only) because pmbook has 1 hour that day
data.lighter: ~/lighter-import/YYYY-MM-DD.csv.gz (Tokyo export, top 3, exchange + Tokyo receive ms); all-zero rows = book unknown, no liquidity until the next non-zero row
data.outcome: Lighter outcomes.csv (2 = Up, 1 = Down); windows without a known outcome are dropped
data.fees: Polymarket rate * p(1-p) per share at each fill price, rate per window from reports/dublin/fees_by_window.csv (census), else 0.07 before 2026-11-21 00:00 UTC window start and 0.05 from then; Lighter 0.01 p(1-p)

splits.dev_note: Dublin has no complete 11-24 (14 h): excluded
splits.validation_note: descriptive only, run after PF1_pick.json is pushed; 11-27 ends ~09:20 UTC
splits.holdout_note: read once on/after 2026-12-05, after the operator re-exports Lighter 11-28..12-04

execution_model.views_at_dublin: Polymarket: Dublin's recorded receive time of each row (= exchange time + measured Dublin lag, per row); Lighter: exchange time + 2 ms + lag (lag 100 or 120 ms)
execution_model.trigger: on every view update, pair cost after both fees >= threshold below $1 (side a: Lighter Up ask + PM Down ask (1 - Up bid); side b: Lighter Down (1 - Up bid) + PM Up ask), both books valid, min(Lighter top size, PM top size) >= 5, from window start + 5 s to window end - 1.25 s; 5 s pause after each attempt (either side); if both sides fire at once, the larger edge
execution_model.pm_leg_first: FAK buy of the PM token at seen ask + L c (<= 0.99), sent trigger + 2 ms, matched at send + 5 ms + PM taker hold (150 ms = 'live' scenario; also 250 ms) on the book in force at that exchange time; strict: fills only displayed size at <= limit over the top 3 levels
execution_model.lighter_leg: IOC at the trigger's Lighter price + M c (buy Up <= ask + M on side a; sell Up >= bid - M on side b); (a) sent at PM match + 10 ms with size = PM filled (no order if < 5), (b) sent with the PM order (trigger + 2 ms), size q; arrives +100 ms, matched after the 300 ms Lighter taker hold (send + 400 ms); strict fill over the top 3 levels
execution_model.unwind_sell: PM shares without a Lighter fill: taker sell at the PM bid, sent at Lighter-no-fill known at Dublin (Lighter match + 100 ms) + 50 ms, matched + 5 ms + hold, fee charged; (b) Lighter filled but PM not: close on Lighter at its bid/ask, sent when both results are known at Dublin, +100 ms, matched after its 300 ms hold, fee charged. Remainders < 5 shares (both venues' minimum) and anything the top 3 levels cannot absorb are held to settlement
execution_model.unwind_hold: reported: unmatched shares held to settlement instead
execution_model.clip: q = 5 shares (primary); also reported: q = min(Lighter top size, PM top size, 200) at the trigger (PM hold 150, unwind sell only)
execution_model.pnl: every leg booked as Up/Down shares with cash and fees; unwinds book proceeds; the window outcome settles the rest
execution_model.per_attempted_share: 100 * sum(P&L) / sum(q over attempts), including unwinds and held residuals

report_per_cell: c/share per attempted share net of everything
90% CI of $/day by window bootstrap (4000, seed 0)
share of $ from the last 2 minutes
dev_pick: among the 36 cells at Lighter view lag 120 ms (primary variant), the highest 90% lower bound of $/day among cells with >= 20 attempts/day; ties -> higher c/share. Written to frozen/PF1_pick.json with the code commit and pushed before the validation days are run
stop_early: if no dev cell (primary variant, either lag) has a positive c/share point estimate under (a) or (b): write PF1 up as closed, no pick
holdout_pass_all: frozen pick c/share per attempted share >= +2.0 including unwinds
